name: H & K Fabrication - Pipe Welding and Fabrication Tools
old_description: We’re the ultimate destination for professional pipe welders seeking precision, durability, and performance in their pipe welding tools. Our carefully curated selection of pipe welding equipment is engineered to help pipe welders do their job easier and more efficiently.
about:
H & K Fabrication operates from Conway, Arkansas, where it designs and sells pipe welding tools and provides custom metal fabrication services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company's product line includes Roll Out Wheels, Pipe Fitting Squares, Roller Heads, Lathe Chucks, and a range of specialty clamps, squares, and jack stands. All tools feature a zinc-plated finish. In addition to stocked tools, H & K Fabrication runs a custom fabrication shop that builds one-off projects such as custom bus racks and sanitizer stands for local businesses. The shop performs welding, machining, and assembly work.

Primary customers are professional pipe welders and pipefitters who purchase tools directly through the company's e-commerce site. The custom fabrication side serves local commercial clients needing small-run metalwork, with examples including a bus rack for a transportation outfit and sanitizer stands for a business.

H & K Fabrication emphasizes reliable tools, fast shipping (standard 3–5 business days), and a quality guarantee that replaces damaged or defective tools within 30 days. The company positions its combination of ready-to-ship pipe welding tools and on-demand fabrication as a way to keep welders working efficiently.
